sources.claim: Audited transaction table separates the 1,371,729-share ECP disposal from the 88,729-share contribution to Walsin America; note 4 identifies the contribution as part of establishing and capitalizing Walsin America.
May 24 issuer disclosure states that Walsin America would sell all 2022 Solar Development shares back to the issuer and that actual figures would follow completion.
October 12 supplemental disclosure reports the actual completed transaction as all 88,729 shares, approximately US$175.05 per share and approximately US$15.532 million total consideration.
ECP currently lists New Leaf as a Current July 2022 investment.
ECP and Borrego announced completion of the New Leaf carve-out and sale on July 28, 2022.

independentReview: The PDF table was rendered and inspected rather than inferred from extracted column text. The official MOPS archive did not expose a stable permalink; the May and October issuer filings were cross-checked through separate full reproductions and reconciled to Walsin's audited report.
